name: Improve skill
description: Improve one canonical skill through controlled failure capture, adversarial evaluation, and cross-harness qualification.

states.description: Capture the current skill and its control evaluation results without changing the candidate.
states.stopCondition: Stop when the control baseline is missing, non-repeatable, or not comparable.

states.description: Capture concrete failures, pressure cases, and rationalizations that the skill should prevent.
states.stopCondition: Stop when a claimed failure cannot be reproduced or distinguished from unrelated behavior.

states.description: Apply the smallest wording or supporting-resource change that addresses the captured failure.
states.stopCondition: Stop before editing when the proposed change is not minimal, scoped, or attributable to the failure.

states.description: Run repeated adversarial control and candidate evaluations and compare deterministic evidence.
states.stopCondition: Stop when evaluation samples, inputs, or scoring are not comparable.

states.description: Qualify the changed skill across available harnesses and document unavailable surfaces as not run.
states.stopCondition: Stop successfully only when the candidate improves or preserves the control with no unresolved critical regression.

gates.requirement: The control input, samples, and scores are durable and repeatable.
Failure and rationalization cases are concrete and reproducible.
Only the smallest attributable wording or resource change is made.
Repeated control and candidate evaluations use comparable inputs and scoring.
Available harnesses qualify the candidate and unavailable ones are marked not run.

successCriteria: The candidate change is attributable to a captured failure and remains minimal.
Repeated adversarial evidence shows no critical regression and records cross-harness limitations.
